metric_scope: Primitive AST constructor nodes; variable labels stored inside mem/all nodes, with label magnitudes and encoding costs uncharged. DAG shares only identical named subformulas, not alpha-equivalent formulas. NOT machine states, register instructions, program bits, or compiled costs.
semantic_scope: All 530 labeled nonempty membership structures of sizes 1..3. Direct bit-mask semantics are compared to the fixed DP, BU and EPSC[Theta] formulas, and to four ordinary/unary fused instances. This validates those formula encodings and the LB guard, not full-schema satisfaction or the repair-equivalence theorem. DP, BU and EPSC[Theta] are not asserted logically equivalent without EPSC1.
